high_level_description: The image is a collage featuring three individuals, with the central figure being a black-and-white photograph of James Dean. The top left section shows Andrew Garfield, dressed in a white tuxedo with a black bow tie, smiling warmly at the camera. The top right section features Ryan Gosling, also in formal attire, wearing a dark suit jacket over a light-colored shirt, with a more serious expression. The central circular photo is a black-and-white image of James Dean, who is depicted in a leather jacket, looking directly at the camera with a confident and slightly intense expression.
